newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Volkswagen to recall 500,000 cars in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen to recall 500,000 cars in Brazil.

text.p: The Brazilian unit of Volkswagen AG said it was recalling 500,000 cars to replace faulty fuel lines.
Volkswagen's announcement followed a statement by Ford Motor Co's Brazilian unit earlier today which said Ford was recalling 100,000 cars whose motors were supplied by Volkswagen.
All 600,000 cars contain the faulty fuel lines, which can crack prematurely and cause fires, the two companies said.
"The fuel lines will be replaced free of charge with a new line made from another kind of material," Volkswagen do Brasil said in a statement.
It said it was recalling the following models:
* Santanas and Quantums built between February 1993 and September 1996,
* Logus and Pointers built between May 1994 and September 1996,
* Novo Gols and Paratis built between July 1994 and September 1996.
Ford said it was recalling Escort models produced in Brazil between May 1994 and September 1996, and Versaille models made between February 1993 and September 1996.
The 100,000 cars being recalled by Ford represent about 45 percent of Ford's annual vehicle output in Brazil, Ford said.
Volkswagen's recall represents nearly 90 percent of its annual vehicle output in the country. Volkswagen is Brazil's largest automaker, producing more than 550,000 cars a year.
